canonical_question: Does the DSC heating/cooling range up to 1450°C capture the full solidification and melting behavior of the eutectic without missing high-temperature peritectic reactions?

question_variants.question: Does the DSC heating/cooling range up to 1450°C capture the full solidification and melting behavior of the eutectic without missing high-temperature peritectic reactions?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text states the DSC range is up to 1450°C but does not confirm if this range captures all solidification/melting behavior or rules out high-temperature peritectic reactions outside this window.

answers.answer: The text indicates measurements were taken to 1450°C but does not validate whether this captures the full behavior or excludes high-temperature peritectic reactions.
answers.boundary_limitation: No confirmation of full range capture provided.
evidence_spans: our alloy design strategy resulted in the discovery of an EHEA with a fine lamellar fcc/B2 structure and balanced high fracture strength and high ductility.
we successfully designed a highly uniform AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 EHEA, with an unprecedented combination of castability, high fracture strength and high ductility.
The bulk EHEA ingot of ~2.5 kg in weight was prepared by the conventional casting method using the commercially pure raw materials.

source_evidence_spans: measured from ambient temperature to 1450°C, during both the heating and cooling process
